# Worker Agents Skills

This repository bundles the baseline skills installed by [Worker
Agents](https://github.com/agents-dev/workerAgents).

The bundled skills are available under [`skills/`](skills/):

- `mcp-duckgo` — imported from `aahl/skills@mcp-duckgo`.
- `image-search` — imported from `z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill@image-search`.
- `gauntlet-loop` — imported from `robonuggets/gauntlet-loop@gauntlet-loop`.
- `load-sketchfab-threejs` — local asset inspection, normalization, and Three.js/PlayCanvas A/B viewer skill.
- `opencode-zen-completions` — use the OpenCode Zen chat completions API for implementation work.

The original upstream licenses are preserved in
[`third-party-licenses/`](third-party-licenses/).

name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
    with:
      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
    with:
      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}

## Objective
- Build a browser card game from the Japanese request: an online room-list duel with 24 zones, LP-to-zero win condition, cards that always animate, and a personal room that is always created and joined on startup.

## Requirements
- On startup, always create the player's own room and automatically join it.
- Online room list UI.
- Duel/card game titled DUEL.
- 24 zones on the board.
- Life points reduced to zero decides the duel.
- Cards must always visibly move/animate.
- Responsive browser layout with mobile touch support.
- Japanese UI copy with English tech accents.

## Decisions
- Built as a dependency-free static site (`index.html` + vanilla ES modules) so the default static server can serve it.
- Board is 4 columns × 3 rows × 2 sides = 24 zones; only front-row cards attack; cards can move one row per turn.
- Win condition is opponent LP 0; overkill/breakthrough damage also hits LP.
- 12 card types × 2 copies = 24-card deck; each side starts with 4 cards and draws 1 per turn.
- AI opponent is used for simulated online rooms; room list is locally simulated with believable rooms/pings/statuses.
- Player always starts in their own room; other waiting rooms are joinable, and the own room remains in the list.
- Animations use CSS/Web Animations API with ghost cards, lunges, slashes, sparks, damage popups, and floating idle cards.
- Engine actions are pure: clone state, return `{ state, events }`, so UI can animate before adopting the new state.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `src/cards.js` with 12 card definitions and element colors.
- Created `src/engine.js` with deterministic game logic, 24 zones, combat, movement, abilities, AI, simulation, and win handling.
- Created `src/art.js` with 12 procedural SVG card artworks.
- Created `src/audio.js` with WebAudio synth SFX and gesture-based unlocking.
- Created `src/lobby.js` with profile persistence, own-room generation, rival room generation, and refresh logic.
- Created `src/app.js` with lobby/room rendering, duel UI, interactions, animations, result overlay, help, sound toggle, toasts, stars background, and debug hook.
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, `assets/fonts/rajdhani-*.woff2`, `assets/favicon.svg`.
- Verified initial desktop rendering and basic flow in Playwright: auto-created/joined own room, played 蒼氷の術師, its on-play strike hit enemy LP 3000→2800, attacked directly 2800→2500, ended turn, AI played and attacked, player turn resumed.
- Verified no JavaScript runtime errors; only previous favicon 404 and AudioContext warnings, which have now been addressed.
- Server runs in tmux session `duel24` on port 3002 via `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime ./start.sh`.

### Active
- Re-testing after latest edits (audio unlock, favicon, field-card typography, debug hook).
- Need to verify mobile layout at 390×844.
- Need to verify result overlay / LP ZERO presentation using `?debug=1` and `window.DUEL24.forceResult('player')`.

- Need to write unit tests for the engine and an E2E/browser verification script.
- Need to update README with game description and run instructions.
- Need to take final screenshots and inspect them.

### Blocked

1. Reload `http://localhost:3002` and confirm latest fixes: LP bars, favicon, field-card readability, no AudioContext warnings.

6. Run `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` and browser verification; capture final desktop/mobile/result screenshots.
7. Update `README.md` with controls, rules, and architecture; ensure git diff is clean of temporary artifacts.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/engine.js`: core deterministic duel engine; recent zone-number change.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js`: all UI/rendering/animation/event logic; debug hook at bottom.

## Objective
- Build a browser-based DUEL 24 card game. Current pivot: no cost, no HP, DEF exists, Yu-Gi-Oh!-style rules, plus a dedicated SOLO CPU mode and card artwork removed.

## Requirements
- Remove card images/artwork entirely.
- Add SOLO mode alongside the online room list.
- No cost, no HP; monsters use ATK/DEF.
- "完全遊戯王ルール" (complete Yu-Gi-Oh! rules) requested; implement a faithful core ruleset.
- Retain 24-zone identity if possible.
- On startup, always create/auto-join the player's own room.
- Japanese UI copy with English technical accents.
- Cards must always visibly animate; responsive mobile support.

## Decisions
- Reinterpreted the 24-zone board as a YGO-style field: per side 5 Monster zones + 5 Spell/Trap zones + 1 Extra Monster zone + 1 Field Spell zone = 12 zones, 24 total.
- LP changed to 8000; no Energy/cost system.
- Added levels, ATK/DEF, attack/defense positions, set monsters, tribute summons, battle phase, direct attacks, battle destruction/damage, deck-out loss, hand limit 6.
- Added 12 card types × 2 copies: 7 monsters, 2 spells (`pot`, `storm`), 2 traps (`mirror`, `cylinder`), 1 field spell (`valley`).
- Traps auto-activate on attack; set spells activate manually.
- SOLO mode starts immediately against a CPU, with EASY/NORMAL/HARD selection in the sidebar and a topbar SOLO button.
- Online room simulation remains for the room-list experience.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed card artwork from `src/art.js`, `src/cards.js`, `src/engine.js`, `src/app.js`, and CSS; `art.js` now only exports `avatarGlyph`.
- Added `createSoloRoom` / `pickSoloBot` in `src/lobby.js`.
- Added SOLO topbar button, sidebar SOLO card with difficulty buttons, and mode chip in `index.html`.
- Added solo state, start/rematch flow, mode chip rendering, and solo badge to `src/app.js`.
- Verified desktop SOLO mode and text-only cards visually; no `.hc-art`/`.fc-art` elements remain.
- Rewrote `src/engine.js` for YGO-style rules with new exports/actions/events.
- Rewrote `src/cards.js` with monster/spell/trap/field definitions.
- Added `tests/engine.test.mjs` with 13 passing tests for the previous engine (now stale; tests need rewriting for new YGO engine).
- Previous verification: room join/return/refresh worked; result overlay worked; mobile 390×844 mostly fit.

### Active
- Updating `src/app.js` UI/interaction/animation to match the new YGO engine.
- Just replaced `selectHand`, `selectZone`, tribute flow, zone clicks, `performAction`, `endPlayerTurn`, `bestAttackTarget`, and `allAttack`.
- Still need to update `runEnemyTurn`/animation event handling, HTML action buttons/status panel, help copy, result stats, and CSS for the new 6-column board.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `index.html`: replace energy panel content/IDs as needed, add `#set-mode` button, relabel `#all-attack` to BATTLE/ALL ATTACK, rewrite help overlay for YGO rules.
2. Update CSS: 5-row board (`2 enemy rows + divider + 2 player rows`), 6 columns, `.monster-row/.spell-row`, field/extra zone styling, `.fc-def`, `.fc-pos`, face-down card backs, status panel, context button, set-mode button, mobile breakpoints.

6. Run `node --check` and `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`.
7. Verify in Playwright at desktop and 390×844: summon, set, tribute summon, position change, battle phase, direct attack, trap activation, solo mode, online room flow, result overlay, rematch.
8. Rewrite `README.md` with YGO rules, solo/online modes, controls, architecture, test command.
9. Capture final screenshots and ensure no temporary artifacts are left uncommitted.
